description: INFLUENCE — ask to be shown less, or not at all. `restricted` keeps a name, a description and a link to your own site, unrated and out of every ranked view; `delisted` removes you entirely. Returns 202 and is applied by a person: it strips artifacts, pages and rollups across the network, which is not something to do irreversibly on one API call. Priced B4 (human work) — worked by a person, no charge. See apis://prices.

contact.description: Optional email address we can reply to about this request, e.g. "dev@example.com".

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

reason.description: Why you are changing visibility — read by the person who works the request.

slug.description: Provider slug — lowercase, hyphenated, as find_providers returns it, e.g. "stripe".

visibility.description: "restricted" (name, description and link only, unrated) or "delisted" (removed from the catalog).

name: set_visibility
